transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Hi. Well, I came in because... for the last few weeks, I’ve barely had an appetite. It's just, even the foods I usually look forward to after a shift, they just sit there. I pretty much have to force down a few bites.
Have you been feeling sad or hopeless lately?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. It's more like... most days I just feel like I’m carrying this heavy, flat feeling around. Even when I’m home with my family or, you know, just sitting in the break room on shift... I’m just not really there. It just kind of weighs on me.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I mean... I used to really look forward to my morning runs, or playing my guitar, and even just cooking dinner. But lately, I just keep skipping them. They just feel like chores now, and I can’t really get myself to care about doing any of it.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead or thoughts of hurting yourself?

No, I’m not planning to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I guess I do keep having these thoughts lately that maybe it wouldn’t be the worst thing if I just didn't wake up. You know, just so I wouldn't have to keep pushing through all this every day. It's just exhausting.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, flat mood?

It's been about three weeks now. I think it really started right around the time the casino reorganized our security operations. They changed up my assignments, and... yeah, it's just been going on since then.
Have you noticed a significant change in your energy level during these past few weeks?

No, not really. I mean, I'm tired because I'm just kind of dragging myself through the day, but my actual energy... like, physically... it feels about the same. I just don't have the motivation to use it, I guess.
Have you noticed any change in your sleep since these feelings began?
No, my sleep has been pretty normal. I still get about the same amount of sleep I usually do. I haven't had any trouble falling asleep or waking up in the middle of the night or anything like that.
Have you had difficulty concentrating or making decisions during these past few weeks?

Yeah, I have. It's been pretty noticeable at work, actually. When I'm watching the CCTV feeds or trying to write up my incident reports, my mind just... drifts. I find myself having to reread the same paragraph over and over again. It's frustrating because it's led to me making a few mistakes lately that I normally wouldn't make. It's just hard to stay focused.
Do these low mood and loss-of-interest feelings continue even when you are away from work and not thinking about the casino reorganization?

Yeah, they do. It's not just about the job or the reorganization. Most days I feel like I'm carrying this... this heavy, flat feeling around with me everywhere. Even when I'm home with my family, or just sitting in the break room on my downtime, it doesn't go away. It just feels like I'm not really there.
